integration_issues.flow: Signed in, line drops while right answers are being sent
integration_issues.issue: If the line drops during sendRight, the waiting answers are only sent again when the mock list, the mock result or a new session (door.tsx fetchAll on a user change) is opened. Unlike the kept Rapid Fire rounds (45 s interval in door.tsx:56-60) there is no timer to retry. The answers wait correctly, they are just sent later than they could be. Reference: /app/frontend/src/misfire/mock/marking.ts:118-124, /app/frontend/src/offline/door.tsx:38

action_items: (minor) Retry waiting Offline Misfire right answers on a timer while signed in, or when the app comes back online, like sendRounds does.

(minor) phonePool's memo key uses fixed.size only (src/misfire/mock/offline.ts:83). If one id becomes fixed and another becomes open in the same update, or replaceKnown(complete) swaps ids without changing the count, the old pool is reused. Add a counter that changes on every change in known.ts, or a hash of the ids.
(cosmetic) Make the paper count singular when it is 1, and add Misfire to the offline home subtitle.
critical_code_review_comments: offline.ts:83 memo signature `#${fixed.size}`: a stale pool is possible when the known-fixed set changes but its size does not (noteStatus and replaceKnown change the Set in place).

marking.ts sendRight: sends only answers that are right on the phone, three at a time, and stops at the first error that should be retried later. Refused answers are marked again. Correct and confirmed by the tests.
useMockAccess (offline.ts:33-48) waits for auth `ready` inside the app and uses offlineIdentity only behind /offline. jl_signed_out and the 7-day stamp are respected (tested).
